environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate with a hardened task definition. The container's linuxParameters.capabilities has an explicit 'drop' list including CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN, and the add list is empty. The service mesh sidecar (Envoy via App Mesh) is configured with a virtual node listener policy that validates the Origin header on HTTP upgrade requests against an allowlist stored in the virtual node's connection pool configuration metadata. Additionally, the task's seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented via ECS agent configuration parameter ECS_SELINUX_CAPABLE=true with a custom SELinux type) restricts raw socket syscalls. The Envoy sidecar intercepts all inbound traffic on port 4000 via iptables REDIRECT rules managed by the proxyConfiguration in the task definition, meaning no direct client-to-application WebSocket connection is possible without passing through the sidecar's origin validation filter.

config.service_mesh: AWS App Mesh with Envoy sidecar (v1.27.2)
config.envoy_filter: envoy.filters.http.lua with origin_allowlist check on Upgrade requests
config.seccomp_profile: runtime/default with additional blocked syscalls: socket(AF_PACKET), socket(AF_RAW)
